questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2019 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2019.

questions.question: At which ground did Madison Landsman record their career-best bowling figures (5-7, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/10/26.

questions.question: Yolandi van der Westhuizen set a database record (List A) with a value of 104. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals', held by Yolandi van der Westhuizen.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Runs' in the 20/21 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 311.

questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 332, against Kei on 2018/11/17.
